cost: ADDED to data/anchors.json: Joakim Noah '15 attr:perdef 78 +-3 (reads 80).

Amen Thompson '26 def 97 +-2 now reads 95 with his perdef 98 -> 96. It read 95 before this round too, so the round costs him nothing, but the pin is ON its lower edge and any later round that shaves perdef on a carried-ballot 2026 wing breaks it. His u is 0.739 (p74 steals) and the remaining slack in his DEF is zero.

The round does NOT reopen recal_149's constants (TRK_BAND_LO/TOP/W) or recal_159's load line (BAND_FOOT/BAND_FULL). Both were measured as routes to the subject and both are the wrong knob: they charge the whole class for one card's ballot provenance.
Klay Thompson '16/'17/'18 (drep carried from his 2019 All-Defensive 2nd, p30-ish steals) lose 4-5 perdef and 3-4 DEF. None is pinned; his OFF and OVR are untouched except through DEF.

A later ruling that wants the carried-ballot discount on a DIFFERENT axis than steals should know that the tracked reading itself and DBPM both point the OTHER way on this pair: Noah '15 is 68.51 / p95 against Amen '26's 65.47 / p80.
notes: THE FINDING. recal_149's tracked-band credit is paid through wv = min(1, drep/0.30), and drep is a CAREER reputation decayed 15% a year in both directions. So a season with no ballot of its own collects the credit at full band membership on a ballot cast for a DIFFERENT season. Joakim Noah '15 is that card: 2014 DPOY, 2015 DPOY share 0.006 (under recal_20's 0.05 trace line) and no All-Defensive team, own credit 0.003 against drep 0.850. The credit took him perdef 73 -> 89 and DEF to 96 on 30.6 mpg, 7.2 ppg, 0.7 spg and DBPM 2.0 — tied 2nd of 2015 with Anthony Davis, above Draymond '15 (95), DeAndre Jordan (94) and Duncan (93). recal_149's receipt disclosed the rise as 'a real and arguable side effect' and it was never ruled by name.

THE RULE. The carried share of drep unlocks the band credit only in proportion to what THIS season's own sheet certifies: u = (own + cert*(drep - own))/drep, cert = P['stl'], the within-season steal-rate percentile. recal_160 drew this line ('a ballot cast FOR this season is not a ballot carried from another') and recal_165 gave it its shape on the rim side, where the restoring evidence is _measured_rim_evidence (blocks x DBPM) because a rim ballot claims deterrence. A PERIMETER ballot claims perimeter defence, and this file's perimeter counting stat is the steal rate — it is what perimdisrupt is built from. NO NEW CONSTANT: the percentile is read raw off the P dict the file already builds, with no bar and no ramp.

THE SEPARATION, AND WHY IT IS NOT _q149 OR DBPM. Amen Thompson '26 has the SAME provenance as the subject — own 2026 credit 0.006, the whole 0.850 carried from 2025 — and he is recal_149's own pin at def 97 +-2 reading 95 with no slack. On the tracked axis and on DBPM the subject is the BETTER card (regressed tracked reading 68.51 vs 65.47, -3.8% over 625 attempts vs -3.2% over 517; DBPM percentile 0.950 vs 0.797), so a gate on _q149 or on DBPM takes Amen and leaves Noah. The steal rate is the one own-season axis that separates them and it separates them by a distance: Noah '15 p22 of 2015 (0.7 a game over 30.6 minutes, STL% 1.1), Amen '26 p74 of 2026. Their u's are 0.222 and 0.739.

WHERE THE FACTOR LANDS — the variant that missed, measured on the whole pool. Multiplying _pd149's credit in COMPOSITE space (PD + W*sample*q*load*u, the tidier edit) lands the subject at perdef 82 / DEF 95, ONE POINT outside 78 +-3, because the same fractional shrink in PD space buys a different number of card points at every point of the Pvot density: Noah sits in the dense middle of 2015 so a 78% cut of his composite credit is only a 44% cut of his card points, while Amen '26 is past the top of the 2026 pool where a cut costs nothing at all. Unlocking the PAYMENT instead is the same rule for every card wherever it sits, and it reaches 80.

MONOTONE AND ONE-WAY BY CONSTRUCTION. u is in [0, 1] and multiplies a max(0, ...): at u = 1 the line is byte-identical to recal_149 (PD2 + max(0, X - PD2) IS max(PD2, X)), at u = 0 it is byte-identical to pre-149, the Pvot pool is the same frozen pool, no card rises and no card falls below its pre-149 value. Every card whose ballot is its OWN (own == drep) is byte-identical: Draymond '15/'16, Kawhi '16/'17/'20, Jrue '21, Marcus Smart '19, Dort '25, Giannis '20, Gobert '21, Anthony Davis '15, Bam Adebayo '20/'21, OG Anunoby '26, Amen Thompson '25, Ben Simmons '21.

MEASURED ON THE POOL: 74 cards move perdef, ALL down, 8 by more than 3, largest 9 (the subject). 55 move DEF, all down, one by 4 (Klay Thompson '17). 28 move OVR, all down, none by more than 2. The 2015 defensive board now reads Kawhi 98 / Davis 96 / Draymond 95 / DeAndre Jordan 94 / Noah 94, which is the complaint answered.
